newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTO STRIKER OUT FOR THREE MONTHS AFTER INJURY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO STRIKER OUT FOR THREE MONTHS AFTER INJURY.

text.p: Portuguese champions Porto's top striker Domingos Oliveira underwent a knee operation on Wednesday and will be out of action for three months, a club doctor said.
"The operation went well but recovery will not take less than three months," Domingos Gomes said.
Domingos, the top league scorer last season, tore ligaments in his right knee during training.
